Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

revolt noun

also defection, desertion, rebellion, falling away

classical

Caes. BG 3.10: rebelliō facta post dēditiōnem, dēfectiō datīs obsidibus (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Q. Fr. 1.4.4 (Lewis & Short)

dēfectiō, dēfectiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a falling away: desertion, revolt; a failing, a giving out

Examples

  • rebelliō facta post dēditiōnem, dēfectiō datīs obsidibus

    a renewal of war after surrender, a revolt after hostages had been givenCaes. BG 3.10 (Lewis & Short)

See also mutiny, abandon.
